children: RIYADH — Saudi Assistant Minister of Interior Dr. Hisham Al-Falih and Kuwaiti Ministry of Interior Undersecretary Lt. Gen. Abdulwahab Al-Wuhaib co-chaired the third meeting of the Military and Security Coordination Committee via videoconference on Monday. The committee was established under the Saudi-Kuwaiti Coordination Council.
The meeting reviewed agenda items and discussed several joint initiatives in security-related fields, as well as ways to strengthen cooperation and coordination between the two sides.
